entries.o: <fe><02><0a><34><34><34><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>Will fighting always\nbe a part of history?
<fe><02><0a><34><34><34><62><5f><30><30><34><37><00>Really? I thought it'd\nrip his hand off.
<fe><02><0a><34><34><34><62><5f><30><30><36><37><00>I wonder how many people\nhave tested their courage?
<fe><02><0a><34><34><34><63><5f><30><30><31><35><00>We should just give up\non the barrel.
<fe><02><0a><34><34><35><63><5f><30><30><30><35><00>If everyone in the world\nwere as practical as you,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><34><34><35><63><5f><30><30><30><36><00>then life would be much\neasier.
<fe><02><0a><34><34><35><63><5f><30><30><32><31><00>It seems the curse\nwas still in effect.
<fe><02><0a><34><34><35><63><5f><30><30><33><33><00>No, it's my fault. I've\nasked too much of you.
<fe><02><0a><34><34><35><63><5f><30><30><34><32><00>The torn chains are\nhanging from the wall.
<fe><02><0a><34><34><32><63><5f><30><30><34><32><00>A person with a lot of\nfree time, if you ask me.
<fe><02><0a><34><35><33><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>Wow, Fia. You know so\nmuch about the land.
<fe><02><0a><34><35><33><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>These rocks look kinda\nneat. Can we take some?
<fe><02><0a><34><35><33><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>I take it all the buildings\nare made of these rocks?
<fe><02><0a><34><35><33><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>Yes, that's why the city\nlooks so white.
<fe><02><0a><34><35><34><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I can't believe water\ncan be such a pain.
<fe><02><0a><34><35><34><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>They say that Tetyth\nbegan sinking,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><34><35><34><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>because the people here\nangered the gods.
<fe><02><0a><34><35><34><62><5f><30><30><34><38><00>The wings of the bat\nare on the ground.
<fe><02><0a><34><35><34><62><5f><30><30><36><38><00>If it's an enemy, I'd\nrather go unnoticed.
<fe><02><0a><34><36><32><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Many people came here\nwaiting for a savior.
<fe><02><0a><34><36><32><61><5f><30><30><31><30><00>I can hear the water.\nWe have to hurry.
<fe><02><0a><34><36><32><61><5f><30><30><31><33><00>You picked up a key of\nthis color, didn'tcha?
<fe><02><0a><34><36><32><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>We should put it back.\nIt feels wrong opening it.
<fe><02><0a><34><36><32><63><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Oh! Did you save my\nlittle sister, Iria?

<fe><02><0a><34><36><32><63><5f><30><30><30><37><00>I'm Aria. The other Undines\nand I live around here.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><34><36><32><63><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Hmmm... What do you want\nas a reward?
<fe><02><0a><34><36><32><63><5f><30><30><31><34><00>On second thought,\ncome back in a bit.
<fe><02><0a><34><36><31><61><5f><30><30><31><30><00>You do so, and don't forget\nto say your thanks!
<fe><02><0a><34><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>I never imagined they\ncould be this high...
<fe><02><0a><34><37><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>And such lewd attire,\nshowing off so much skin!
<fe><02><0a><34><37><33><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>But then, everyone'll\nbe torn limb by limb...
<fe><02><09><65><32><35><5f><30><30><30><34><00>I'm glad that we were able\nto talk things out.
<fe><02><0a><34><38><32><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>We have no choice but\nto defeat them.
<fe><02><0a><34><38><32><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>I think we can make it onto\nthat statue...

<fe><02><0a><34><38><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>After lookin' at this\ncathedral for a while,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><34><38><33><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>I kinda understand the\nreason why Tetyth sunk...
<fe><02><0a><34><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>They may have tried to talk\nto the gods from here...
<fe><02><0a><34><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>...An angel burdened with\nthe sins of others.

<fe><02><0a><34><38><34><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>As an angel of Asgard,\nI will defeat you!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><34><38><34><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>You shall atone for your\nsins. Prepare yourself!
<fe><02><09><65><33><31><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Hmph... Wingless, and yet you\nstill serve Asgard?<fe><00><fe><02><09><65><33><31><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Knave... My Ancardia shall\neradicate you!
<fe><02><0a><34><38><34><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>Have we redeemed\nthe Tetythians?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><34><38><34><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>I certainly hope\nthey appreciate this.
<fe><02><0a><34><38><31><61><5f><30><30><32><30><00>You're letting your\nemotions interfere.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><34><38><31><61><5f><30><30><32><31><00>If you won't pass\njudgment, then I will.
<fe><02><0a><34><39><32><61><5f><30><30><30><35><00>I'm just looking for\nitems in this ditch.
<fe><02><0a><34><39><32><61><5f><30><30><31><32><00>I swear I just saw the\nforehead shine...
<fe><02><0a><34><39><32><61><5f><30><30><32><30><00>I can feel divine energy\nemitting from it.
<fe><02><0a><34><39><32><61><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Thank you very much.\nI can feel its energy.
<fe><02><0a><34><39><32><62><5f><30><30><31><36><00>How long do you plan to\nlook at her butt?
<fe><02><0a><34><39><33><61><5f><30><30><31><33><00>The less words, the better\nfor me. Words bore me.
<fe><02><0a><34><39><33><61><5f><30><30><34><32><00>...Don't point the finger\nat me if anything happens.
<fe><02><0a><34><39><34><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>...but looking around here\nis makin' me sleepy...
<fe><02><0a><34><39><35><61><5f><30><30><31><36><00>At the very least,\nwe'll have this memo.

<fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><67><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Ein's party sealed the Accursed and\nescaped the sinking Tetyth.<fe><00><fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><67><5f><30><30><30><31><00>There was no remnant of the once glorious\ncity, but only a mirror of the lost past...<fe><00><fe><02><0d><6c><6f><67><75><65><5f><67><5f><30><30><30><32><00>While heading back to Elendia, Ein runs into Ledah...

<fe><02><0a><35><31><32><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>Can you hear that?\nIt sounds pretty noisy.
<fe><02><0a><35><31><32><62><5f><30><30><34><31><00>How dare you steal from\na little girl!
<fe><02><0a><35><31><32><62><5f><30><30><37><32><00>This really is an ideal\nhideout for thieves.
<fe><02><0a><35><31><32><62><5f><30><30><38><36><00>I bet it was that guy\nwho bumped into you...
